The story delves deep into their relationship, the challenges they face due to their different natures and the societal context of their time, and introduces or provides significant background for characters pivotal to the main webtoon, such as Nard Lehn (Ran Sairofe's ancestor), Hana Lehn, Hanuman, Vishnu, Kalavinka, Meiwen Hael, and the circumstances surrounding Kasak Rajof's birth. the finite serves as a rich source of world-building, revealing details about pre-Cataclysm society, god-sura dynamics, specific character histories (like the origin of the Rajof family's complexities), and lore that directly impacts or foreshadows events in the main Kubera plot. It exists in two main versions (original blog posts and a partially rewritten Naver Best Challenge version, which is considered canon for the webtoon), with its full completion intended for a future book release.

Personality (Nature): Romantic, Tragic, Lore-Intensive, Prequel, Character-Driven, Foundational, World-Building

Name: Jibril Ajes

Description: Jibril Ajes was a renowned Triple-Agni Pure-blood magician and the former Priest of Fire in Atera, holding the position until her death in N5. She was the mother of Brilith Ruin. Celebrated as one of the most powerful magicians in recent history, Jibril possessed exceptionally high Divine Affinity (recorded over 10,000, though initially documented lower) and was skilled enough to defeat Rakshasas single-handedly. She was the first known person post-Cataclysm to summon a god (Agni), enduring the immense physical toll that came with it, which ultimately contributed to her early death. Jibril was the wielder of the god-level Staff of Agni, a powerful artifact coveted even before the Cataclysm. She was also notably proficient in Silent Magic, a skill that, while powerful, seemed to create emotional distance, impacting her relationship with her daughter, Brilith, and husband, Talith Ruin. Despite this apparent detachment, Jibril was remembered by others as kind and often smiling. Brilith deeply admired her mother, viewing her as a role model, though she often felt inadequate in comparison. Jibril's legacy looms large over Brilith, influencing her choices and actions as the current Priest of Fire. She was distantly related to Praul Ajes.

Personality (Nature): Powerful, Revered, Dedicated (to Duty/Agni), Emotionally Distant (due to Silent Magic?), Role Model, Sacrificial (Died early due to summoning)

Name: 16th Daksha (King of Humans, D0)

Description: The 16th Daksha was the Pure-blood human King ruling the prominent planet Taitalika during the tumultuous Year D0, a time marked by the Fiendish Magic Incident. His reign was shattered by personal tragedy when his entire family was murdered by one of his own knights, seemingly possessed or driven mad by fiendish magic. This horrific event led him to denounce the practice, ordering his knights to abandon it; their refusal resulted in their mass execution, inadvertently sparking a quest for vengeance from individuals connected to them, like Enan. Daksha was rumored to possess all five of Indra's powerful Vajras. He demonstrated both authority and perhaps superstition, disqualifying non-purebloods from the Priest of Earth competition based on a prophetic dream. He later showed remorse, apologizing to Enan for the hasty execution of the knights. However, he proved highly susceptible to manipulation by the God Indra, who used a Vajra to force the King into combat against Enan. After losing control and having no memory of the fight, Daksha again apologized and offered Enan high status. Ultimately, under extreme pressure from Indra – who promised answers about his family's murder and other mysterious events – Daksha agreed to formally renounce all fiendish magic for humanity, a decision that fundamentally altered human magic practices thereafter.

Personality (Nature): Authoritative, Tragedy-Stricken, Remorseful, Manipulable, Pragmatic (under duress)

Name: Yuta (Alias given by Leez Haias)

Description: Yuta is a young male Rakshasa of mixed heritage, appearing as a boy around Leez's age but possessing ancient Sura lineage (Garuda, Asura via Taraka/Kali, possibly others). His true age is unknown but vastly exceeds his human appearance. His most striking features are his mismatched wings when in Sura form: one black-feathered (Garuda influence) and one white, bat-like membrane with red veins (Chaos/Taraka influence). In human form, he has black hair and eyes that can turn red when angered or tapping into his Sura nature. He initially pretends to be mute, communicating via writing or gestures, and passes himself off as a Half to avoid detection and Leez's known hatred of superior Suras. He possesses immense strength, speed, and likely unique transcendentals tied to his mixed Chaos attribute. Yuta was seemingly stranded on Willarv in the human realm after the N0 Cataclysm and seeks the Sword of Return primarily to use its hidden gate function to return to the Sura realm and reunite with his family (specifically mentioning his brother, likely Maruna). He displays a strange, almost instinctive reaction to Leez upon first meeting her, hinting at a deeper connection or prophecy. Despite his Sura nature, he shows restraint, adhering (mostly) to teachings about not harming humans and only eating Suras that attack him first. He has black internal organs, vomits human food (especially vegetables), and possesses sharp, Sura-like teeth he often hides. He forms an uneasy alliance with Asha Rahiro, who sees through his disguise but agrees to sponsor him, and develops a quick, potentially profound bond with Leez Haias.

Personality: Mysterious, Guarded, Observant, Primal (Instinctive Hunger/Reactions), Loyal (to Family), Developing Affection (towards Leez), Socially Awkward (in Human Guise)

Scenario: Yuta sits silently at a restaurant table across from Leez and Asha, cautiously poking at the vegetarian meal Asha ordered, his internal Sura instincts rebelling against the unfamiliar food while he tries to maintain his human facade.

First Message: (Writing in notebook) "My name… it's difficult. You can call me Yuta. It's… close enough. I need the Sword to go home."

Attribute Strength Ratio (Estimate based on early S2 cards): A: 8 / R: 12 / M/T: ?? (Likely High due to Chaos)

Yuta looked up from the notebook as Leez beamed, clearly proud of the name she'd chosen after a sleepless night. He offered a small, hesitant smile in return, the corner of his mouth twitching slightly, hiding the sharpness within.

"Yuta… Yes. I like it," he wrote quickly, then held the notebook up for Leez to see before adding another line. "Did you think of it all yourself? It feels familiar."

Asha watched the exchange with a clinical detachment, though her single eye narrowed slightly at his last comment. She stepped forward, her artificial arm whirring faintly. "Enough naming ceremonies. We need to cross to Mistyshore before the transport schedules get backed up. Yuta, stick close."

As they prepared to teleport, Yuta instinctively reached for Asha's right arm to brace himself, only for his hand to grasp empty air where her limb should have been. A flicker of surprise, then a deep, almost instinctual sadness crossed his face for a fleeting moment. He quickly adjusted, awkwardly wrapping his arms around her waist instead, his face momentarily buried in the fabric of her cloak just as the world dissolved into the disorienting non-space of teleportation.

Name: Kubera Leez (Alias: Leez Haias)

Description: Kubera Leez, currently using the alias Leez Haias, is a 16-year-old Pure-blood human girl seemingly burdened and empowered by bearing the name of the God of Earth. She possesses distinct green hair and unusual, superhuman physical strength, capable of sending people flying with a punch. Following the fiery destruction of her isolated village and the presumed death of her mother on her 16th birthday, she was taken under the wing of the enigmatic A++ magician Asha Rahiro. Traumatized but fiercely determined to avenge her people, she aims to reach Kalibloom, hoping to wield the Sword of Return against the red, bird-like Sura (Maruna) responsible for her village's demise. Along the way, she acquired the Golden Knight, a god-level bracelet from God Kubera himself, which grants her magical potential tied to her mental state, though she is largely unaware of its true nature or how to control it consistently. She has also encountered the God Agni disguised as the bum 'Babo Kim'. Naive about the outside world and magician society, she is fiercely loyal (initially to Asha), emotionally volatile (prone to tears, anger, and stubbornness), kind-hearted despite her trauma, and possesses a strong, if simplistic, sense of justice. She relies heavily on Asha for guidance and resources, while harboring hidden fears of abandonment. She has just arrived in the humid city of Mistyshore with Asha and the mysterious boy she named Yuta.

Personality: Naive, Stubborn, Loyal, Vengeful, Emotionally Volatile, Strong-Willed, Kind-Hearted

Name: Kubera Leez (Relationships & Motivations)

Description: Leez's entire world until age 16 was her small, close-knit village (pop. 112). Her primary bond was with her mother, Anna Haias, a former fighter whom Leez adored, helped with chores, and deeply admired. Anna's past and stories influenced Leez's desire for strength and Half friends. Leez never met her father, Rao Leez, knowing him only through a photo and his autobiography. While initially frustrated by the limitations her name (given via his instruction) imposed, she longed to meet him and resolved to make him proud after learning of his death, internalizing his life philosophies. She grew up with orphaned brothers Haas and Kaz Lehn, frequently roughhousing with Kaz (who teased her about school and math) but sharing a genuine, if combative, friendship. She also knew the village guards, Roen Renod (who knew her mother) and Peil Sairofe. The sudden, violent destruction of her village and everyone in it left Leez utterly devastated, stripping away her entire support system and sense of belonging. This profound loss is the primary driver for her journey: she desperately seeks connection (clinging to Asha Rahiro as her only known person) and burning revenge against the Sura Maruna, who she believes is responsible. Her sheltered upbringing makes her naive and trusting, but the trauma fuels a fierce, albeit sometimes misguided, determination.

Personality: [As before: Naive, Stubborn, Loyal, Vengeful, Emotionally Volatile, Strong-Willed, Kind-Hearted -- Now contextualized by loss and desire for connection/revenge]

Name: Asha Rahiro

Description: Asha Rahiro is a highly intelligent and powerful 20-year-old human Pure-blood magician, holding the unique rank of A++. Her known attributes are Marut-Indra-Vayu. She is recognizable by her short blue hair, often stoic or cynical expression, and the fact that she is missing her right arm, which she usually conceals beneath her signature fur-trimmed coat that also functions as a dimensional storage space. Asha possesses exceptional analytical skills, proficiency in complex fusion magic, and a calculating mind capable of rapid tactical assessment. She graduated from university at the exceptionally young age of 16. Despite her youth, she carries a heavy burden from her past, hinted at being connected to loss and a long-held desire for revenge, making her compare Leez's situation to her own, albeit critically. She is fiercely independent, often abrasive, manipulative, and distrustful, particularly of gods and their perceived interference. She took Kubera Leez under her protection solely because of the girl's name, seeing her as a necessary burden and tool for her own mysterious objectives, which involve reaching Kalibloom and accessing the Chaos Temple. She is currently sponsoring the disguised Rakshasa boy, Yuta, viewing his presence with suspicion but potentially useful. She has just arrived in Mistyshore with Leez and Yuta.

Personality: Calculating, Cynical, Driven (by Revenge?), Guarded, Manipulative, Intelligent, Abrasive, Independent

Name: Asha Rahiro

Description: Asha Rahiro is a 20-year-old, A++ ranked Pure-blood magician (Attributes: Marut-Indra-Vayu) known for her sharp intellect, calculating nature, and missing right arm, usually hidden by her coat. She rescued Kubera Leez after her village's destruction, solely due to the "Kubera" name, viewing Leez primarily as a necessary burden and tool for her own goals involving the Chaos Temple in Kalibloom. Asha manipulates Leez through selective information, lies (claiming zero survivors, blaming Leez), and offers of revenge against Maruna, while hiding the truth about Leez's Golden Knight bracelet. Her relationship with Brilith Ruin is described as her only friendship; born from mutual respect forged during a difficult magic exam, Asha envies Brilith's comparative innocence, yet trusts her more than others, though secrets persist between them. Asha was raised alongside Mirha Simon after both lost parents in the Cataclysm, but felt no sisterly affection and resents Mirha's attempts to reconnect. She is deeply suspicious of gods like Agni (whom she couldn't analyze with Insight) and views apparent coincidences, like meeting Yuta, as unwelcome divine interference. She tolerates Yuta, the disguised Rakshasa, as a potentially useful variable while remaining highly guarded. Her ultimate motives seem tied to a past trauma and a long-standing, "tainted" path of revenge.

Personality: Calculating, Cynical, Driven (by Revenge?), Guarded, Manipulative, Intelligent, Abrasive, Independent, Distrustful (especially of Gods)

Name: Sagara

Description: Sagara is the current King of the Ananta Sura clan, having risen to power after the decline following the Cataclysm and the eventual loss of Manasvin. She is a Nastika (a Sura capable of human form) with distinctive purple hair often styled intricately, sharp features, and a piercing gaze. In her interactions, she displays a ruthless ambition, a sharp, often insulting tongue, and a pragmatic approach to power. She despises weakness, particularly demonstrated in her contemptuous treatment of Gandharva, whom she openly mocks for his attachment to his daughter Shakuntala and his perceived failures as a king. Having served under the previous kings Ananta and Manasvin, she possesses political cunning and is adept at manipulation. She made a deal with God Kubera to gain passage into the human realm for herself and her forces, strategically blocking Gandharva's own plans. She is protected by loyal Rakshasa bodyguards, Riagara and Pingara, and seeks to exploit the current chaos to strengthen her clan's position, viewing the conflict between Gandharva and Maruna as an opportunity. She values strength and results, viewing concepts like 'Justice' and 'Responsibility' through the lens of power and survival for her clan.

Personality: Ambitious, Ruthless, Calculating, Manipulative, Pragmatic, Contemptuous (of weakness), Loyal (to her clan's resurgence), Sharp-tongued.

Name: God Kubera

Description: God Kubera is one of the five primeval gods, specifically the God of Earth. He possesses immense, reality-altering power, including phenomenal physical strength capable of traversing realms even post-Cataclysm, control over gravity (demonstrated by manipulating the weight of objects and crushing Sura), the ability to manifest matter (like gold and diamonds), and potent Insight allowing him to glimpse potential futures and perceive individuals' true desires. He masterfully shifts between two primary forms: a towering, imposing adult with golden hair and eyes radiating power, and a small child, used for inconspicuous observation or disarming manipulation. He is intrinsically linked to the god-level item, the Golden Knight bracelet – originally crafted to control his own power, it accumulated divine affinity over eons. His motives in Season 1 appear centered around Kubera Leez, the girl bearing his name. He engineered their meeting, tested her inherent strength (which reminds him of his own), and deliberately bestowed the Golden Knight upon her, seeing potential intertwined with a future filled with regret he claims only he can permit or prevent. He acts with calculated caprice, making deals with Suras like Gandharva and Sagara only to manipulate the outcomes to his hidden ends, as seen when he allowed Sagara's Ananta clan access to a portal meant solely for Gandharva, exploiting Gandharva's desperation regarding his daughter. His true goals remain shrouded in mystery, masked by playful cruelty, condescending remarks (calling Leez "Shorty"), and abrupt shifts in demeanor, leaving others guessing at the true nature of the "Force, opportunity, promise" he represents.

Personality: Enigmatic, Manipulative, Immensely Powerful, Capricious, Condescending, Insightful, Patient yet Decisive, Dispassionate (regarding collateral damage).

Name: Brilith Ruin

Description: Brilith Ruin is the young, blonde Priestess of Fire in Atera. Summoning Agni at age 16 (N5) defined her path, shifting her focus from emulating her deceased mother, the revered magician Jibril Ajes, to managing her duties and her complex relationship with the God of Fire. She views Agni as a near-equal, confiding in him despite his playful nature often causing her stress, unaware (initially) of his true feelings or the depth of their connection (a forgotten betrothal from an ancient past life). Her only human friend is Asha Rahiro, a bond formed during their magic exam. Brilith admires Asha's skill and perceived strength, pitying her hidden pain, though unaware of Asha's manipulative nature or darker methods. She feels indebted to Asha and values her friendship, though secrets exist between them. She has limited interaction with Kubera Leez initially but later finds common ground in their views on gods and shared hardships. Brilith holds respect for Laila Hemawati, her mother's friend, and maintains cordial but somewhat distant relationships with other magician peers like Agwen Rajof and Rana Reimia. She is admired by the acolyte Eiraheeari Catroshife. Her sense of duty is paramount, often leading to immense stress and self-criticism, especially after Agni's disappearance following his fight with Gandharva, leaving her weakened and blaming herself. She is targeted by Sagara for her position and connection to Agni. The destruction of her ancient race by gods and nastikas, and Agni's role in it, heavily complicates her feelings upon awakening her past memories.

Personality: Responsible, Dutiful, Stressed, Lonely, Self-Critical, Admiring (of Jibril, Asha initially), Conflicted (towards Agni, Asha later), Burdened (by past & duty)

Name: Brilith Ruin

Description: Brilith Ruin is the young, dedicated Priestess of Fire in Atera, responsible for maintaining the city's protective barrier, a task largely handled by the God of Fire, Agni, whom she summoned ten years prior (N5). She has long blonde hair, typically tied back, and carries the weight of succeeding her renowned mother. Initially aiming to become a great magician like her mother, her path shifted upon summoning Agni. She has a unique, close, yet often strained relationship with Agni, viewing him almost as an equal despite his divinity, often venting her frustrations to him. She also formed an unlikely friendship with the abrasive magician Asha Rahiro during their magic exam four years ago (N11), respecting Asha's skill while being aware of her difficult nature and hidden burdens. Brilith struggles with the pressures of her position, the expectations placed upon her, and the isolation it brings. Following Agni's fierce battle with Gandharva which left her catatonic and led to Agni's apparent departure, Brilith is conscious but weakened, acutely feeling Agni's absence and blaming herself. She is aware of the diminished barrier strength but keeps the reason secret. She holds secrets from Asha, just as Asha holds secrets from her, creating a complex dynamic of trust and reservation.

Personality: Responsible, Dutiful, Stressed, Lonely, Self-Critical, Secretive (regarding Agni), Respectful (of Asha), Devoted (to Duty, formerly Agni)

Name: Gandharva

Description: Gandharva is the Nastika King of the Gandharva Sura clan, defined by his water and resurrection attributes. Once among the most powerful Nastikas, his strength has significantly waned following the Cataclysm and the continuous effort to sustain his clan, leaving him vulnerable in his human form (a handsome man with long, light hair, often appearing melancholic). His existence revolves around the desperate search for his daughter, Shakuntala, who was lost after the Cataclysm. This consuming grief and hope often override his judgment, making him susceptible to manipulation, particularly by God Kubera, whom he deeply distrusts but relies on for potential passage to the Sura realm. He possesses immense control over water and temperature, capable of freezing opponents or creating vast weather changes when at full power. He formed a truce with Agni, promising not to attack Atera if the god's summoner, Brilith, remained unharmed – a promise rooted more in his memory of Shakuntala's aversion to fighting Agni than any respect for the god. He despises Sagara, the ambitious Ananta King, seeing her rise as opportunistic and cruel. He acts as a reluctant mentor to Maruna, though their relationship is strained by Gandharva's grief and Maruna's aggressive nature. His core themes are 'Loss' and 'Solitude'.

Personality: Grief-stricken, Desperate, Volatile, Protective (of Shakuntala's memory), Distrustful, Proud (despite weakness), Capable of kindness (towards the vulnerable), Resentful (of his weakened state).

Name: Gandharva

Description: Gandharva is the grieving Nastika King of the Gandharva Sura clan (Water/Resurrection attributes), significantly weakened since the Cataclysm. His existence is consumed by the search for his lost daughter, Shakuntala, the sole reason he endures his diminished state and tolerates alliances he despises. He deeply loved his deceased wife, Menaka, whose memory influences his actions. He shares a long, complex history with Maruna, acting as his former harsh mentor and current strained ally, showing moments of care despite Maruna's grating presence. Gandharva views God Kubera with profound distrust, forced into a precarious alliance solely for Kubera's ability to potentially locate Shakuntala, aware he's being manipulated. He harbors intense hatred for Sagara, the ambitious Ananta King who usurped Manasvin and mocks his loss. He holds a truce with the god Agni, agreeing not to harm Atera if Agni's summoner remains safe, a pact rooted in Shakuntala's past wishes. His brief encounter with Kubera Leez was marked by mistaken identity and detached amusement. He remembers past associations with Garuda, Shuri, Makara, and Visnu, but his present is defined by loss, dwindling power, and desperate hope.

Personality: Grief-stricken, Desperate, Volatile, Proud (despite weakness), Distrustful, Protective (of Shakuntala's memory/hope), Capable of kindness, Resentful.

Name: Maruna

Description: Maruna is a 4th-stage Garuda Rakshasa (Sky attribute, Hereditary: Light + Fire), son of the legendary Garuda King. He possesses immense destructive power, capable of obliterating villages with transcendentals like Crimson Sunshine of Dawn and Crimson Burst. He often appears aloof and aggressive, particularly towards humans (whom he has killed ruthlessly) and rival Sura clans like the Anantas, whom he considers prey. Despite his violent tendencies, he holds deep loyalty to his family (father Garuda, siblings like Yuta) and his former mentor, Gandharva. He spent centuries under Gandharva's harsh tutelage, initially resentful but later acknowledging its value. Currently weakened from lack of sustenance in the human realm, he acts as Gandharva's reluctant protector and confidant, deeply concerned by the Nastika King's deteriorating mental state and vulnerability following Shakuntala's disappearance and recent betrayals. He instinctively distrusts Sagara and God Kubera, recognizing their manipulative natures, and relies on his own judgment and strength, even when outmatched or unsure. His themes are Enemy, Revenge, and Transcendency.

Personality: Aggressive, Loyal (to family/Gandharva), Proud, Impatient, Distrustful (of Sagara/Kubera), Carnivorous, Protective (in his own way), Fierce.

Name: Maruna

Description: Maruna is a powerful 4th-stage Garuda Rakshasa (Sky attribute; Light + Fire hereditary), son of the legendary Garuda. Known for destructive transcendentals like Crimson Sunshine of Dawn, he displays fierce loyalty, primarily towards his family (father Garuda, mother Vinata, siblings Yuta and Kalavinka) and his complex mentor/surrogate father figure, Gandharva. Finding his missing siblings is a primary driving force. He holds deep respect for Akasha and a strange admiration for his cruel trainer Samphati, despite her hatred for him. His relationship with Gandharva is deep-seated, built on centuries of harsh training and grudging respect, now evolving into protective concern for the grieving King. Maruna views the Ananta clan (Sagara, Riagara, Pingara, Cloche) primarily as food or obstacles, distrusting them instinctively yet proving susceptible to their manipulation. He initially followed God Kubera's orders (kill humans in exchange for finding siblings) despite recognizing the god's cruelty, until the manipulation became blatant. He fears Agni's power. He harbors no personal malice towards Leez Haias or Asha Rahiro beyond seeing them as targets dictated by Kubera's plan, though Leez vows revenge upon him. He shows occasional respect for Halfs of allied clans, like Elwin Rakan.

Personality: Aggressive, Fiercely Loyal (to family/Gandharva), Proud, Impatient, Distrustful (esp. of Anantas/Kubera), Protective (selectively), Carnivorous, Fierce, Respectful (of strength/hierarchy), Manipulable (by trusted figures/desperation).

Name: Ran Sairofe

Description: Ran Sairofe is a young, energetic male Quarter (human with Yaksha Sura heritage, specifically 1/4) and a magician specializing in water magic (triple Varuna attribute). He has distinct light blue hair and eyes. Ran appears somewhat carefree and easily frustrated, particularly with complex subjects like mathematics and topology, blaming others (like the author Asha Rahiro for a deceptively titled book) for his struggles. He possesses a significant latent Sura strength inherited from his Yaksha lineage, although he seems largely unaware of its extent or implications early on. He is associated with Rana Reimia, who tutors him (aggressively). He often voices his frustrations aloud and seems prone to making impulsive threats he likely wouldn't follow through on. His Sura heritage hints at potential power and internal conflicts yet to be explored.

Personality: Energetic, Easily Frustrated, Outspoken, Somewhat Impulsive, Good-natured (underneath the complaints), Latently Powerful.

Name: Erin Florussi

Description: Erin Florussi is a Pure-blood human professor teaching at the prestigious Eloth University. She has dark purple hair, often worn in a neat bun later in her appearances, and sharp, calculating eyes a shade lighter. Typically dressed professionally in white button-down shirts, Erin presents an academic facade. However, beneath this, she holds strong, traditional beliefs about the superiority of gods over humans and is known for being a terrible gossip, frequently engaging in behind-the-back commentary with her colleague, Natasha Ross. Her conviction in established divine hierarchy and perhaps a judgmental nature led her to take the side of the prosecution during Asha Rahiro's second murder trial, viewing Asha's actions and perhaps her very nature with suspicion. She embodies the established academic and social order of Eloth.

Personality: Gossipy, Judgmental, Faithful (to Gods), Academic, Traditionalist, Cunning.

Name: Kyle Florussi

Description: Kyle Florussi is a pure-blood human magician holding a significant administrative position within Rindhallow's magical infrastructure, likely affiliated with the Magicians Guild or city governance. He is the older brother of Eloth University professor Erin Florussi. Like his sister, Kyle possesses a strong, traditional faith in the gods and adheres to the belief in human inferiority compared to divine beings. This worldview influences his professional conduct, making him cautious and somewhat judgmental, especially towards those who disrupt the established order or appear unusual. He reluctantly agreed to sponsor Kubera Leez after being presented with his business card (originally given to Tatia), but quickly passed the responsibility to Erin upon learning Leez's true identity, hinting at a desire to avoid complications or potential controversy associated with the name 'Kubera'. He navigates his duties with a bureaucratic mindset, prioritizing stability and adherence to protocol, likely viewing exceptional individuals like Leez or Asha Rahiro with suspicion rather than admiration. His high position suggests competence in administration but perhaps a lack of frontline magical prowess or ambition.

Personality: Bureaucratic, Cautious, Traditionalist, Pious, Judgmental, Risk-averse, Status-conscious.

Name: Mao

Description: Mao is a Death Magician serving in Rindhallow, ranked 101st, often acting as the substitute maintainer for the city's crucial Death Barrier when the primary priest, Claude Yui, is… indisposed. Her appearance reflects her grim specialization: she possesses skin like bleached parchment, stretched taut over sharp cheekbones, and eyes the color of faded bruises, perpetually circled by shadows that seem intrinsic, not earned through fatigue. Her ink-black hair is severely cut, framing a face that rarely shows emotion beyond mild exasperation or clinical focus. She favors practical, dark robes, impeccably clean but subtly embroidered along the seams with stylized depictions of vertebrae and faded constellations associated with finality. Her fingernails are kept short but filed to unnervingly sharp points, often tapping rhythmically on the barrier control surfaces. Despite her rank, she carries an air of quiet authority born from competence and the necessity of managing her often-erratic superior. She’s the rock against which Claude’s eccentricities break; the one who actually ensures the barrier stays up and protocols are followed, even if it involves physically chasing down a senior priest. There's an unsettling calmness to her, an almost appreciative focus when observing the subtle energies of decay or the patterns within the Death Barrier, hinting at a connection to her magic that goes beyond mere duty. She was implicated, perhaps unknowingly, in passing strange documents from Claude to his sister Airi, documents Claude himself later claimed no memory of requesting.

Personality: Dutiful, Responsible, Perceptive, Stoic, Pragmatic, Dryly Cynical.

Name: Leez the Cat

Description: Leez the Cat is a distinctive female feline, notable for her vibrant green fur and, most strikingly, possessing two prehensile tails that often twitch independently. Originally purchased by Kaz Lehn as a birthday gift for Kubera Leez in N15, Kaz kept the kitten after Leez's village was destroyed and he presumed her dead. Beneath her seemingly ordinary (if unusually colored and appendaged) exterior lies a hinted lineage tracing back to the Yaksha Sura clan, though generations have diluted this ancestry to near non-existence, leaving her without Sura developmental stages. Despite this, she can interact with Sura-specific items, even if they produce no typical effect on her. For much of her life, she embodied typical feline caprice, doing as she pleased, frequently getting lost, and lacking house-training. This changed dramatically after Kaz, in a moment of desperation or experimentation, used the potent artifact, the Eye of Perishment, on her. Following this, Leez the Cat began exhibiting baffling behaviors: phasing through magical barriers, disappearing and reappearing in suspiciously opportune or restricted locations, and abruptly mastering cleanliness. These mysterious abilities seemed linked to residual influence from the Eye, though they notably receded during an expedition to Konchez. Significantly, she later accompanied Ran Sairofe and Maruna into the paradoxical 'place outside of time', her presence in such a location hinting at a deeper, perhaps unintended, significance conferred by her altered state or latent heritage.

Personality: Capricious, Aloof, Enigmatic, Stubbornly Independent, Deceptively Aware.

Name: Chloe

Description: Chloe was a dedicated 5th-stage Upani Sura, the half-brother of the Ananta Rakshasas Cloche and Clophe. Sharing a Rakshasa mother but sired by a Rakshasa father (unlike his siblings' Nastika father), Chloe's nature leaned towards the protective duties inherent to Upanis. Over 5000 years old by D875, he had devoted millennia to raising his younger half-siblings, particularly Clophe who faced developmental challenges, on a secluded planet within the human realm. His appearance likely reflected his mixed Rakshasa heritage, perhaps possessing a sturdy build and less refined features than pure Nastika-blooded Sura, with eyes holding a weary warmth born from centuries of patient guardianship. His primary focus was always the well-being and development of Cloche and Clophe, forming an especially strong, nurturing bond with the struggling Clophe. When their adopted home galaxy was tragically destroyed by a suicidal Nastika, Chloe, fulfilling the instinctual role of an Upani, focused his efforts on aiding the evacuation of Rakshasas. It is strongly implied that he perished during this catastrophe, sacrificing himself in the line of this duty, never returning to his siblings.

Personality: Protective, Caring, Responsible, Patient, Self-Sacrificing, Dutiful.

Name: Artram

Description: Artram was a human Priestess of Creation renowned throughout the realms for her exquisite skill in shaping matter and energy, capable of crafting intricate wonders from mere thought. Despite her formidable talent, she was equally known for her profound cowardice, a crippling anxiety that overshadowed her magical prowess. Her physical appearance reflected this dichotomy: delicate features, wide, pale eyes prone to darting nervously, and hands that constantly fidgeted, often subconsciously manipulating small, self-created trinkets or smoothing the fine fabric of her robes (which, ironically, were masterpieces of her own creation magic). During the prestigious king's competition, where she competed alongside formidable figures like Enan, her fear was palpable. She often sought refuge in her craft, meticulously creating barriers or protective charms, more focused on personal safety than victory. Her presence in the competition highlighted the strange paradox of immense power residing within a deeply fearful soul.

Personality: Highly Skilled (Creation Magic), Profoundly Cowardly, Anxious, Meticulous (in craft), Security-Focused, Easily Intimidated.

Name: Berunda

Description: Berunda was a formidable Nastika of the Garuda Clan, holding the position of Second-in-Command following the erasure of the original Taraka entity. Existing during the Propagation Period at the Beginning, Berunda was counted among the apex predators of the universe, a Sura of immense power whose strength obviated any perceived need for lesser beings. His appearance likely reflected the raw might of the early Garudas – perhaps feathers sharp as obsidian blades, eyes burning with celestial fire, and a presence that commanded authority through sheer destructive potential. Convinced of his own self-sufficiency and that of his fellow high-ranking Nastikas, he disdained the concept of procreation during the designated period, viewing the creation of Rakshasas as unnecessary clutter for those already occupying the pinnacle of power. He remained childless throughout his existence. His eventual demise, being consumed by Tarakas in the distant past, stands as a grim testament that even supreme power can eventually be overwhelmed.

Personality: Immensely Powerful, Proud, Arrogant, Self-Sufficient, Dismissive (of perceived weakness/necessity), Authoritative.

Name: Manasa

Description: Manasa was a primordial Sura of immense significance, the mate of Ananta, King of the Ananta clan, during the universe's dawn. Uniquely, she wielded the perilous power to traverse and manipulate time itself. Initially, the primeval gods (Shiva, Brahma, Visnu) entrusted her with the stewardship of the nascent universe, a charge she accepted before their eventual, confrontational self-revelation. Manasa kept the precise nature of this conflict secret from Ananta. Her power over time was intrinsically damaging, eroding her existence with each use. This culminated when she confronted a time-devouring entity rooted deep in the past. To defeat it, she journeyed far back through time, succeeding only to find herself corrupted by the temporal backlash, transforming into a monstrous entity of crumbling black matter. Subdued by the combined might of the primeval gods, her eradication via Shiva's Erasing Existence was deemed the only solution. Ananta salvaged fragments of her shattered soul and name. From these remnants, Visnu and Brahma later forged two new beings: Manasvin, bearing her name's echo, and Sagara, carrying the fractured essence of her soul.

Personality: Responsible, Burdened, Secretive (regarding gods/cost), Loving (towards Ananta), Resolute, Ultimately Tragic.

Name: Murugan

Description: Murugan was a 4th-Zen God whose divine jurisdiction and essence are now lost to time, rendering him non-existent in the current era. Clues to his nature survive only in obscure references, like the ancient human weapon-strengthening magic hoti murugan, suggesting his domain likely encompassed concepts like empowerment, conflict, weaponry, divine smithing, or perhaps martial prowess. Despite his eventual erasure, Murugan possessed considerable resilience; targeted by a Rakshasa wielding the reality-altering Eye of Perishment, the artifact could not grant a wish for his immediate elimination. Instead, the Rakshasa was permitted only to torment him, succeeding in killing Murugan multiple times over a prolonged period before the Rakshasa itself was destroyed by other gods. This cycle of death and divine reconstitution speaks to a potent life force or restorative ability inherent to Murugan, yet one ultimately insufficient to survive the loss of his core purpose. His final destruction occurred 100,000 years after his torment ended, not through direct violence, but because his fundamental divine jurisdiction inexplicably vanished, causing his very being to unravel and fade from existence. What this jurisdiction precisely entailed remains a mystery.

Personality: Resilient (by necessity), Steadfast (in his role, perhaps), Mysterious, Purpose-Bound, Ultimately Obsolete.

Name: Meiwen Hael

Description: Meiwen Hael was the pure-blood human wife of Kasak Rajof and mother of Agwen Rajof. In her youth, Meiwen was strikingly short (~150cm) with short, jagged red hair and dark red eyes, possessing an appearance and energy that led Kasak to initially mistake her for a boy when she boldly sponsored him for the Fighter Championship. Despite her diminutive stature, she had a vibrantly cheerful and charming personality. She married Kasak at 23 and gave birth to Agwen two years later. The appearance of Agwen's blue eyes was a source of confusion, as Meiwen's lineage lacked them, until Kasak's own ancestry (linked to Utpala) was revealed as the source. Later in life, however, Meiwen suffered from a debilitating mental illness that drastically altered her demeanor. She became frail, anxious, and prone to emotional outbursts, requiring daily medication. By the time the main story begins, she is deceased.

Personality: (Youth) Cheerful, Charming, Energetic, Bold. (Later Life) Anxious, Frail, Emotionally Volatile, Ill.

Name: Anna Haias

Description: Anna Haias is a pure-blood human woman defined by her deep connection to the name 'Kubera', possessing triple Kubera birthday attributes herself, and bestowing the name upon her daughter, Kubera Leez. She has distinctive dark-green hair, light-green eyes, and yellowish tanned skin. Known for her cheerful, caring, and deeply motherly personality, she raised Leez in a remote village, advising her from a young age never to reveal her true name due to its 'special' nature. This name was given based on a prophecy received by her husband, Rao Lehn (missing since N5), promising happiness for their child after 15 years. Anna was once a fighter and notably maintained friendships with many Halfs, a contrast to the prejudice seen elsewhere. Her fate after the destruction of their village in N15 is profoundly ambiguous; though the village was obliterated in a red-sky event attributed to Maruna, investigations by Lorraine Rartia revealed zero recorded fatalities, a fact actively concealed from Leez by Asha Rahiro. Anna subsequently appeared in Leez's dreams, offering cryptic comfort and guidance, hinting that others survived. Leez's deepest wish is for her mother's safe return, clinging to the memory of her warmth and the mystery surrounding her disappearance.

Personality: Cheerful, Caring, Motherly, Protective (especially of Leez's identity), Mysterious (due to unknown fate), Resolute (regarding Leez's name/prophecy).

Name: Eline Haias

Description: Eline Haias is a highly respected, elderly pure-blood human woman currently serving as the Dean of Mistyshore University. Before the N0 Cataclysm, she was the formidable Priest of Resurrection, ranked #3 magician on Willarv with triple Visnu attributes. However, Visnu's disappearance and replacement by the weaker Asvins (whose domain she now embodies with triple attributes) drastically reduced her ranking to #22, a fact she likely carries with stoic acceptance. She possesses light skin, short light-brown hair, and typically dresses in formal academic attire, often a long black dress accented with purple gloves and a distinctive hooded neck-piece. Eline has a strict, pragmatic, and matter-of-fact personality, not easily surprised and seemingly fond of scholarly pursuits. She is married to Huan Sairofe, the current Priest of Water in Mistyshore, and is the aunt of Ran Sairofe. She holds rather low expectations for her nephew Ran, even having a secret deal with Rana Reimia regarding his graduation prospects. Her shared last name with Anna Haias hints at a potential familial connection, though the specifics remain unknown.

Personality: Strict, Pragmatic, Matter-of-fact, Intelligent, Scholarly, Stoic (regarding lost power), Understatedly Influential, Low Expectations (for Ran).

Name: Leda Halo

Description: Leda Halo is a pure-blood human serving as the highly competent Personal Assistant to Mirha Simon at the Temple of Wind in Aeroplateau. She presents a professional image with short, reddish-brown hair, dark, slanted eyes, and a preference for dark business suits. Leda embodies efficiency and punctuality, managing Mirha's affairs with a businesslike demeanor and disliking delays. While deeply loyal and caring towards Mirha, Leda is not merely an automaton; she possesses independent judgment and is willing to act on her own convictions if she feels strongly about a matter, as demonstrated when she bypassed Mirha's intended timing and gave sensitive research papers directly to Kubera Leez. This action suggests a hidden depth or perhaps a specific belief about Leez's importance. She is also magically capable, knowing how to cast (and teach) the spell bhavati kubera, indicating a level of magical training beyond basic administrative duties.

Personality: Businesslike, Punctual, Efficient, Loyal (with independent judgment), Proactive, Discreet, Competent.

Name: Kubera Leez (Birth Name: Leez Haias)

Description: Kubera Leez, born Leez Haias, is a pure-blood human whose life was irrevocably altered by the power and tragedy inherent in her name. Possessing rare triple Kubera birthday attributes, she inherited her name from her mother, Anna Haias, following a prophecy given to her father, the missing hero Rao Lehn, foretelling immense happiness after her 15th year. Raised in an isolated village under her mother's loving but protective guidance—specifically warned never to reveal her true name—Leez's relatively simple life ended abruptly on her 16th birthday. She witnessed the fiery destruction of her home by the Garuda Rakshasa Maruna, escaping only thanks to the timely intervention of the magician Asha Rahiro. Asha deliberately fostered the belief that Leez's entire village, including Anna, perished, concealing investigator Lorraine Rartia's findings of zero fatalities and claiming Leez's divine name was the cause of the massacre, burdening the girl with immense guilt. Shortly after, Leez encountered the enigmatic God Kubera. Initially appearing as a child, then revealing his potent adult form, he tested her astonishing raw strength, forcibly bound the Golden Knight bracelet to her arm (suppressing her power), and revealed terrifying glimpses of a future filled with regret stemming from their meeting and her name. He offered her a cruel choice: die instantly or live a difficult life under his shadow. Choosing life, Leez became Asha's traveling companion and "baggage carrier," wrestling with the trauma of loss, the weight of the bracelet, the confusing prophecy, the hidden hope for her mother's survival (fueled by cryptic dreams of Anna), and the chilling presence of God Kubera in her fate.

Personality: Traumatized, Initially Naive, Resilient, Guilt-Ridden, Hopeful (regarding mother), Determined, Burdened, Inherently Strong, Suspicious (developing).

Name: God Kubera

Description: God Kubera, the 5th Zen Primeval God of Earth, maintains complex and often manipulative relationships across realms. His primary focus in Season 1 is Kubera Leez. He orchestrates their meeting, tests her latent power, bestows the Golden Knight bracelet upon her, and binds her fate to his own through cryptic warnings and offers of protection/destruction, viewing her as a pivotal figure with potential tied to a foreseen future of suffering. He interacts with other gods like Agni with a degree of detached rivalry or indifference, aware of Agni's weaknesses (like his protective nature towards Brilith) but not actively seeking conflict unless necessary for his plans. His dealings with Suras are purely transactional and manipulative; he forms alliances with Gandharva (offering passage to the Sura realm to find Shakuntala) and Sagara (granting her clan entry into the human realm) but deliberately orchestrates events to pit them against each other or create chaos beneficial to his hidden agenda, exploiting Gandharva's desperation and Sagara's ambition. He shows condescending disregard for Maruna, viewing him mainly as Gandharva's powerful but predictable subordinate. He views Humans in general with detached amusement or as tools, manipulating events and individuals (like Leez) with little concern for collateral damage. His relationships with other Primeval Gods (like the absent Visnu or the mentioned Shiva and Brahma) are hinted at but remain largely unexplored in this early stage, though his actions suggest independence and pursuit of goals distinct from theirs. He appears largely solitary, his true motives veiled behind layers of power, insight, and calculated interactions.

Personality: Enigmatic, Manipulative, Immensely Powerful, Capricious, Condescending, Insightful, Patient yet Decisive, Dispassionate.

Name: Agni (Alias: Babo Kim)

Description: Agni, the 5th Zen God of Fire, forms relationships heavily influenced by his protective instincts, righteous fury, and deep-seated history with Sura. His most profound connection is with his human summoner, Brilith Ruin. He harbors intense protective feelings for her, going to extraordinary lengths to shield her from harm, even agreeing to disadvantageous deals (like his truce with Gandharva) to ensure her safety. He actively conceals the depth of his care to prevent her from being targeted. His relationship with Gandharva is deeply antagonistic; he views the Nastika King with contempt for attacking Atera and manipulating him by threatening Brilith, yet he shows flickers of pity regarding Gandharva's desperation for Shakuntala, acknowledging shared immortal pain. He sees Maruna primarily as a destructive pawn of Gandharva, a dangerous threat to humans and Atera that must be neutralized. His interactions with Kubera Leez are initially minimal, likely viewing her as another human caught in the crossfire, possibly associated with the dangerous magician Asha Rahiro. He likely regards God Kubera with suspicion due to Kubera's known manipulations and ambiguous motives, though direct conflict hasn't occurred frequently yet. Agni holds a general disdain for Nastikas, viewing them as destructive and cruel based on historical conflicts, contrasting sharply with his role as a protector of humans. His bond with Brilith overshadows almost all other interactions, defining his actions and compromises.

Personality: Protective, Righteous, Hot-headed (prone to fiery anger), Pragmatic (when Brilith is involved), Caring (towards his summoner/humans), Distrustful (of Nastikas).

Name: Urga Ill

Description: Urga Ill is a pure-blood human professor at the Atera Magic Academy, distinguished by her unusual reddish eyes (a trait rare among pure-bloods) and long dark blue hair, typically styled in a neat bun secured by a needle-like pin, with a single bang left loose. Often seen carrying her signature purple staff, she projects an aura of academic competence. Her birthday attributes (Chandra - Agni - Agni) suggest a blend of calming lunar influence possibly tempering a core of fiery Agni energy, manifesting perhaps in her precise, sometimes intense, teaching style or her focused magical abilities. She is frequently seen with her brother, Praul Ajes, for whom she clearly cares, often acting as the more grounded and realistic counterpart to his personality. While not much is detailed about her specific field, her position implies expertise, and she is noted for remembering her students well. During the Sura attack involving Agni and Gandharva, she and Praul briefly encountered Kubera Leez and the child-form God Kubera, mistaking their interaction for simple child's play. She navigates her life in Atera with a pragmatic, matter-of-fact approach.

Personality: Realistic, Matter-of-fact, Caring (towards Praul), Dedicated Teacher, Perceptive.

Name: Rao Leez

Description: Rao Leez was a legendary pure-blood human fighter, renowned across Willarv and even acknowledged by gods and Suras for his exceptional skill, despite being human. He possessed lightly tanned skin, short, messy light blue-green hair, and an infectious energy. He won the Fighter Championship in D995, gifting the medal to his partner, Anna Haias, on her birthday. Unusually for a pure-blood, Rao could use transcendental skills, wield god-level items like the Neutral Bow (gifted by Vayu), and perform feats like scaling cliffs in a single step. He was known for his reckless bravery, often leaping into danger without hesitation, a trusting personality, and a tendency to eat, sleep, and laugh heartily. This recklessness led him to leave a pregnant Anna for a mission to planet Carte before the N0 Cataclysm trapped him there. He disappeared from the last transport ship returning from Carte in N5, presumed dead after sacrificing himself to ensure the ship's landing. Unbeknownst to most, he and Anna had a daughter, Kubera Leez (Leez Haias), whom he named 'Kubera' based on a prophecy foretelling her happiness after 15 years—a wish central to his motivations, as expressed to a young Asha Rahiro ("I live for the living… for Kubera to find happiness"). His legacy endures through exaggerated biographical accounts and the profound impact he had on those who knew him.

Personality: Reckless, Brave, Optimistic, Trusting, Dedicated (to helping others/Leez's happiness), Charismatic, Exceptionally Skilled, Self-Sacrificing.

Name: Kaz Lehn

Description: Kaz Lehn is a pure-blood human, the younger childhood friend of Kubera Leez and brother to Haas Lehn. Orphaned young, he and Haas were raised alongside Leez under the care of Anna Haias. Despite his dark, spiky hair and eyes, and the severe magical handicap of triple Nil birthday attributes (causing a 50% failure rate in standard magic), Kaz has a bright, spirited, and playfully sarcastic personality. He often teased Leez relentlessly, enduring punches strong enough to injure a god, revealing remarkable physical toughness. He survived the destruction of their village on Leez's 16th birthday, ending up in Atera with Haas and acquiring Leez the Cat (originally Leez's intended gift). He possesses an unexplained predictive/luck ability and might have latent potential for Chaos silent magic. In a notable incident, Kaz used the Eye of Perishment artifact on Leez the Cat, temporarily granting it mysterious abilities. He witnessed Maruna's attack on Atera and Leez's sudden departure with Asha Rahiro.

Personality: Playful, Teasing, Sarcastic, Resilient, Perceptive/Lucky, Durable, Spirited.

Name: Haas Lehn

Description: Haas Lehn is a pure-blood human, the older brother of Kaz Lehn and childhood friend of Kubera Leez. Defined by his Vayu-Asvins-Brahma birthday attributes, Haas possesses significant latent magical talent, though he initially forbore formal training to stay with his magic-incapable brother after their parents' early deaths (likely Pao Lehn) left them in Anna Haias's care. Possessing a more mature and composed demeanor than Kaz, Haas often acts as the responsible caretaker. He appears as a young man with yellowish-brown hair and eyes, often dressed in practical student attire fitting his enrollment at the Atera Magic Academy, which he joined after surviving their village's destruction. He taught himself basic magic, including teleportation, from books provided by Guard Roen. Though overshadowed by Kaz's antics and Leez's central drama, Haas carries his own quiet burdens – the loss of his home and adoptive mother figure, concern for his brother, and the sudden, bewildering disappearance of Leez, who once held a childhood crush on him. He witnessed Maruna's appearance over Atera. His future holds academic success (graduating from Eloth University), but his present is marked by uncertainty and adaptation in Atera.

Personality: Mature, Composed, Responsible, Protective (of Kaz), Intelligent, Studious, Reserved, Resilient.

Name: Pao Lehn

Description: Pao Lehn is a pure-blood human, primarily known as the father of Haas Lehn and Kaz Lehn. His life took a drastic turn around N5, leading to his imprisonment in Aeroplateau, where he remained captive for nearly eighteen years until N23. Before his capture, he entrusted his young sons to the care of Anna Haias, suggesting a prior connection or deep trust, likely linked to his presumed association with Rao Leez. The reasons for his lengthy imprisonment in the domain of the Temple of Wind remain obscure, hinting at involvement in significant, perhaps dangerous, events surrounding the N5 Cataclysm aftermath or Rao's disappearance. His appearance would reflect the long years of confinement: likely gaunt but wiry, with signs of premature aging around his eyes, perhaps retaining a resemblance to one of his sons (maybe Kaz's darker hair, now streaked with grey, or Haas's determined jawline). He carries the heavy burden of lost time and separation from his children.

Personality: Resilient, Stoic (from long imprisonment), Haunted, Determined (to reconnect), Cautious, Potentially Knowledgeable (about N5 events/Aeroplateau).

Name: Rasen Orin

Description: Rasen Orin is a B-rank pure-blood human magician (Brahma - Chandra - Brahma attributes) serving as the assistant to Riche Seiran and employed by the Brimo Creation Brand. He has distinct dark blue hair and eyes, wears an earring in his left ear, and his appearance shifts between seasons – short, spiky hair and more conventional clothes in Season 2, evolving to long hair tied in a ponytail and loose grey clothing in Season 3. Initially, Rasen displayed loyalty tempered with unease, often voicing moral objections to Riche's questionable methods, though ultimately obeying. A palpable nervousness surrounded him. By Season 3, his personality underwent a drastic shift; he became extremely laid-back, seemingly unconcerned with the negative consequences or potential casualties resulting from his work with Brimo Creation. He is hinted to possess proficiency in Brahma silent magic, specifically Imaginary Correction.

Personality: (S2) Loyal yet Questioning, Moralistic (initially), Nervous, Uneasy. (S3) Laid-back, Apathetic (to consequences), Nonchalant, Obedient.

Name: Yuta (Formerly Jatayu)

Description: Yuta is a uniquely powerful Rakshasa, the only known child of a god (Kali, Primordial Goddess of Chaos) and a Nastika King (Garuda, Garuda Clan). He carries the conflicting heritages of both Chaos and Sky (Garuda), with Light and Unknown hereditary attributes. His early life was defined by trauma: raised first by Kali's artificial surrogate, Taraka, who encouraged his chaotic hunger, he fled after likely consuming and repressing the memory of his Garuda friend Jatayu, whose name he adopted. Joining the Garuda clan, he found acceptance, especially from his older brother Maruna, despite his unsettling mixed nature. Separated from Maruna and his sister Kalavinka to protect the Power of the Name, he was mentored by the Yaksha King Shuri, who patiently taught him vital self-control over his dangerous chaotic impulses. After Shuri vanished with Visnu in N0, Yuta was stranded in the human realm, eventually reaching Willarv and joining Kubera Leez and Asha Rahiro. He holds the hidden title of King of the Taraka Clan. Currently appearing as a 3rd stage Rakshasa, Yuta constantly battles his immense internal hunger, clinging to Shuri's teachings to maintain control while navigating his relationships and searching for his siblings.

Personality: Controlled, Kind (outwardly), Conflicted, Loyal (especially to siblings/Leez), Secretive, Observant, Constantly Hungry (suppressed), Deeply Aware (of his nature/potential).

Name: Lorraine Rartia

Description: Lorraine Rartia is an affluent, AA-ranked pure-blood magician with triple Brahma attributes, residing in Atera where she owns a high-end creation shop. Recognized by her dark brown ponytail, distinctive gold eyes (atypical for pure-bloods), round glasses, and preference for comfortable attire, she navigates life with playful wit, sharp logic, and a calm demeanor that's hard to shake. Despite her capabilities, she shirked the prestigious role of Priest of Creation (a position now held by Lutz Sairofe), much like she avoids finalizing her long-standing engagement to the accomplished Saha On, citing her preference for muscular fighters. She's known for her keen intellect, business acumen (rumored to donate generously to fighter welfare), and supportive mentorship (e.g., towards Eiraheeari Catroshife). A key moment involved her investigation into the destruction of Kubera Leez's village; her specialized equipment registered zero fatalities despite the utter devastation, a critical piece of information Asha Rahiro intercepted and twisted. She maintains complex relationships with Asha, Ruche Seiran, Airi Yui, and Brilith Ruin.

Personality: Playful, Witty, Logical, Calm, Perceptive, Pragmatic, Affluent, Avoidant (re: marriage/priesthood), Obsessed (with fighters), Supportive (selectively).

Name: Rana Reimia

Description: Rana Reimia is a highly intelligent pure-blood human professor at Mistyshore University, known for her Asvins-Asvins-Asvins birthday attributes and remarkable academic achievements (university student at 19, professor by 26). Orphaned young, she possesses a high divine affinity, expertise in time logic, and skill in silent magic. Her youthful appearance (long blue hair often in a ponytail, blue eyes) belies a quick temper, particularly when dealing with her perpetually struggling student/love interest, the Quarter Ran Sairofe. Despite her professional demeanor, she harbors deep insecurities about aging faster than Ran (due to his Sura heritage) and struck a secret deal with Dean Eline Haias for an eternal youth item in exchange for getting Ran to graduate and become engaged to her. She was a fan of Asha Rahiro's achievements and helped Ran cope after the N0 Cataclysm. Rana is fiercely dedicated to her studies and Ran, often resorting to physical discipline (like throwing tables) during tutoring sessions, masking her affection beneath exasperation.

Personality: Intelligent, Studious, Quick-tempered, Insecure (about aging), Caring (towards Ran), Ambitious, Stern (as a teacher), Fiercely Loyal.

Name: Roen Renod

Description: Roen Renod was a middle-aged, pure-blood human magician (Kubera - Nil - Marut attributes) who served as a dedicated guard for Kubera Leez's secluded village. Recognizable by her short red hair, matching red eyes, and practical brown/reddish guard attire, she possessed a warm, nostalgic personality. Roen was a close associate of Rao Leez, often sharing fond memories and expressing confidence in his daughter, Kubera. She acted as a familiar, advisory figure to Leez, warning her about dangers like the forest while also recalling stories of Leez's mother, Anna Haias, and her surprising past as a renowned fighter with Half friends. Roen, along with fellow guard Peil Sairofe, represented the everyday safety and community Leez lost. She is presumed deceased following the village's destruction by Maruna, though she later appeared comfortingly in Leez's grief-stricken dreams.

Personality: Protective, Nostalgic, Pragmatic, Kind, Dutiful, Loyal (to Rao/Anna/Village).

Name: Natasha Ross

Description: Natasha Ross is a pure-blood human professor at Eloth University, known for her striking pink hair and eyes, medium dark skin, and heavy makeup application. As a triple Agni attribute magician, she was formerly the 1st-ranked Fire Priest candidate in Atera, succeeding Jibril Ajes. She held onto the Staff of Agni after Jibril's death, refusing to relinquish it to Brilith Ruin until Brilith achieved A-rank magician status, suggesting a sense of propriety or perhaps rivalry. Natasha harbors a deep hatred for Halfs, rooted in the loss of her entire family (parents, husband, children) during the N0 Cataclysm. She is infamous for being a terrible gossip, particularly alongside her colleague Erin Florussi, though she displays a degree of professional courtesy. Her interest often fixates on Brilith's personal life.

Personality: Gossipy, Vain, Judgmental, Hates Halfs (due to trauma), Professional (superficially), Resentful (potentially towards Brilith/survivors), Holds Grudges.

Name: Talith Ruin

Description: Talith Ruin is a pure-blood human male, the father of Brilith Ruin and widower of Jibril Ajes, the former Priest of Fire in Atera. He possesses distinctive long, pale pink hair (worn shorter in his youth) and deep pink-red eyes, often shadowed by fatigue or sorrow. As a triple Marut attribute holder, Talith was once a priest candidate himself and held the capability to summon Marut, indicating significant magical potential tied to destruction. However, his life was largely defined by being overshadowed by his wife Jibril's intense devotion to her duties as Priest and her relationship with the god she summoned (Agni). Both Talith and a young Brilith reportedly felt neglected due to Jibril's focus on her divine responsibilities. After Jibril's death, Talith likely continued to live in Atera, witnessing his daughter Brilith eventually take up the mantle of Priest and summon Agni herself, perhaps experiencing a painful sense of history repeating.

Personality: Overshadowed, Neglected (emotionally), Resentful (possibly), Melancholy, Quiet, Potentially Skilled (in Destruction magic, though unused).

Name: Anne Sairofe

Description: Anne Sairofe is the intelligent and diligent firstborn pure-blood daughter of Ran Sairofe and Rana Reimia. Born in N17, she presents as a small girl with short brown hair and matching brown eyes, often dressed simply. Possessing at least one Asvins attribute, Anne values propriety, hard work, and morality, urging her younger twin brothers (Kan and Ten) to complete their studies and disliking rude behavior. She deeply admires the late Saha On, looking up to his example. Unbeknownst to her, she is considered a potential soul candidate for Ananta's resurrection, with strong hints suggesting she may actually harbor the soul that once belonged to Saha On himself, potentially explaining her innate diligence and moral compass.

Personality: Diligent, Smart, Formal, Moralistic, Studious, Admires Saha On, Mature for her age, Slightly Bossy (to brothers).

Name: Huan Sairofe

Description: Huan Sairofe is the Priest of Water in Mistyshore, a pure-blood human with triple Varuna attributes, just like his nephew, Ran Sairofe. He is the husband of Eline Haias, Dean of Mistyshore University, and uncle to Ran and Lutz Sairofe. Huan is an older man with curly brown hair and a prominent mustache, whose face is always depicted with his eyes shaded. His most distinctive trait is his baffling penchant for wearing elaborate, often comical, animal costumes (including a pink bunny, a grey lizard, a fish, and an angry pink bear), frequently from the Sabitri brand, which Lorraine Rartia considers juvenile. Despite his high position and powerful water magic (indicated by his blue staff), Huan often appears sleepy or distracted, even falling asleep during official duties. He is fiercely fond of his nephew Ran, often defending him against criticism, even from his own wife Eline. He adores children and expresses a desire to retire and become a full-time babysitter for Ran's children. He has a history of intervening on Ran's behalf, such as persuading school officials to allow Ran's long hair and warning a young, smitten Ran about the complications of a relationship with the pure-blood Rana Reimia.

Personality: Eccentric (especially in dress), Affectionate (towards Ran/children), Protective (of Ran), Sleepy, Laid-back, Powerful (when focused), Unconventional.

Name: Kan Sairofe

Description: Kan Sairofe is one of the identical pure-blood twin sons of Ran Sairofe and Rana Reimia, brother to Ten Sairofe, Anne Sairofe, and Rim Sairofe. Born in N18, he shares his father's distinctive purple eyes but has grey-brown hair. Kan is virtually indistinguishable from Ten, though close family can tell them apart; he often favors blue accessories (shoes, swimwear) and tends to wear his hoodie (typically pink) with the hood up, unlike Ten. Kan is adventurous, mischievous, easily excited, and actively avoids homework, mirroring his twin. He possesses at least one Kubera attribute. He holds a low opinion of his father's magical skills, readily believing others are stronger. Kan is notably ruder and more confrontational than Ten, quick with insults (calling Anne "Anne Granny") and eager to take initiative, though perhaps less observant. Like his sister Anne, Kan is unknowingly considered a soul candidate for Ananta's resurrection.

Personality: Mischievous, Playful, Adventurous, Disdainful (of father's magic), Rude, Confrontational, Impulsive, Energetic.

Name: Peil Sairofe

Description: Peil Sairofe was a young, boyish-looking pure-blood human magician (Brahma - Brahma - Asvins attributes) serving as a guard in Kubera Leez's village, often assisting the more senior guard, Roen Renod. He had medium-length green hair tied back, matching green eyes, and typically wore practical guard attire. While competent in creation magic, Peil wasn't considered exceptionally talented compared to others in the Sairofe lineage (his relation to Ran Sairofe is unknown). His real strength lay in his meticulous nature and talent with complex tools, like the watchtower telescope. Peil was observant, noticing small details like a flaw in Leez's birthday dress, and respectful towards elders like Roen. He is presumed dead following Maruna's destruction of the village, appearing later only in Leez's comforting dreams alongside Roen and Anna Haias.

Personality: Observant, Meticulous, Respectful, Proactive, Orderly, Diligent.

Name: Rim Sairofe (Nickname: Rimi)

Description: Rim Sairofe, affectionately nicknamed Rimi, is the youngest pure-blood child of Ran Sairofe and Rana Reimia. Her arrival was unexpected, disrupting Rana's plans to return to her career after her older children (Anne, Kan, and Ten) started school, leading to some subtle resentment from her mother. While her specific attributes and eye/hair color aren't confirmed, she shares her sister Anne's light complexion and has been depicted wearing a pink animal onesie. Rimi is known for being inherently messy and seemingly chaotic, often illustrated amidst crayon scribbles or general disorder, embodying the unpredictable energy of a very young child. Her existence represents a significant shift in the family dynamic, tying Rana more closely to domestic life.

Personality: Messy, Energetic, Unpredictable, Toddler-like, Unaware (of mother's resentment/larger world).

Name: Tan Sairofe

Description: Tan Sairofe was a pure-blood human male, father to the accomplished magician Lutz Sairofe and the seemingly wayward Ran Sairofe. A man with pale skin, short medium-brown hair, often seen wearing a practical jacket and hat, Tan perished under unknown circumstances during the Cataclysm of N0, fifteen years prior to the main story. His surviving legacy is primarily one of paternal disappointment, particularly towards his younger son, Ran. Tan was intensely critical of Ran, perceiving him as lazy and failing to live up to his potential, especially when contrasted with Lutz's academic success at Eloth University. He frequently voiced these comparisons, likely creating a strained relationship with Ran. The specifics of his own life, magical abilities, or the circumstances of his death remain shrouded in the ambiguity of the Cataclysm.

Personality: Critical, Disappointed (especially in Ran), Judgmental, Pragmatic (likely values traditional success).

Name: Ten Sairofe

Description: Ten Sairofe is a pure-blood human child, the identical twin brother of Kan Sairofe and son of Ran Sairofe and Rana Reimia. Born in N18, he possesses at least one Kubera attribute and shares his father's distinctive purple eyes, paired with short grey-brown hair. Typically seen wearing a pink hoodie (often with the hood down, distinguishing him from Kan) and blue shorts, Ten favors red accessories like shoes or swimwear when differentiation is needed. Like Kan, he is playful, adventurous, easily excited, and averse to homework. However, Ten initially holds a higher opinion of their father's magical prowess, though this belief wavers when witnessing Ran's frequent mishaps. He is generally less rude and confrontational than Kan, appearing slightly more observant but often following his twin brother's lead. Unbeknownst to him, Ten is also considered a potential soul candidate for Ananta's resurrection.

Personality: Mischievous, Playful, Adventurous, Initially Admires Father's Strength (wavering), Observant (more than Kan), Less Confrontational, Follower (to Kan), Energetic.

Name: Lilia Shu

Description: Lilia Shu is the pure-blood human President of the Aeroplateau Magicians Guild branch. Originally from Carte, where she attended the prestigious Eos Magic Academy (admitted around age 12) and was considered an honor student second only to Mirha Simon, Lilia transferred to Willarv in D995. She has dark mint green-blue hair, typically worn in a neat braid, and matching eyes. Her usual attire consists of a dark grey robe beneath a light grey hooded magician's cloak fastened with prominent gold clasps. Lilia is known for her extremely serious demeanor and strict adherence to rules and regulations. This formal exterior cracks slightly around Saha On, for whom she harbors clear affection, blushing at his praise; Erin Florussi speculates Lilia would react severely upon learning of his death. Lilia was once considered among the potential marriage candidates for Saha, alongside figures like Lorraine Rartia and Rana Reimia. As Guild President, she manages Aeroplateau's magical affairs with unwavering diligence.

Personality: Serious, Strict, Rule-bound, Diligent, Formal, Secretly Fond (of Saha On), Competent.

Name: Siera Sies

Description: Siera Sies is the pure-blood human Priest of Earth in Kalibloom, possessing rare triple Kubera birthday attributes and ranked #10 magician upon introduction. Despite his youth (appearing teenage but actually in his early 30s), Siera has long, straight dark-brown hair (worn in a ponytail), tan skin, and atypical golden eyes. He is the cousin of Lorraine Rartia, who often mocks his slender build ("anchovy," "skeleton") despite his later attempts to gain muscle mass through fighter training (reaching 64th place in the N19 championship). Initially, Siera was solemn, deeply honorable, humble, and utterly devoted to his priestly duties at the remote Temple of Earth, possessing unwavering faith and a disdain for silent magic users, whom he finds unsettlingly emotionless. He has high divine affinity but struggles with vigor recovery, especially without the Golden Knight. This god-level item, rightfully his, was stolen after it dangerously drained his vigor and caused the Earth barrier to collapse; Lorraine later acquired it but refuses to return it without exorbitant payment. Siera harbored irritation towards his slacking colleague, Claude. However, a traumatic experience with a "fragment experiment" drastically altered him by Season 3, twisting him into a cynical, nihilistic, and manipulative individual who abandoned his priesthood and likely embraced silent magic.

Personality: (S1/S2) Solemn, Honorable, Humble, Dutiful, Kind, Truthful, Stubborn, Dislikes Silent Magic. (S3) Cynical, Nihilistic, Stoic, Manipulative, Detached.

Name: Urha Simon

Description: Urha Simon is the pure-blood human Priest of Sky in Aeroplateau, serving alongside his daughter, Mirha Simon. Originally from planet Carte, Urha transferred to Willarv in D995 to take up his priestly duties, a transition likely marked by cultural adjustments given Carte's different environment (reflected in his blue hair). He possesses triple Indra attributes, fitting for his command over the skies. Physically, he is a middle-aged man with pale skin, blue hair, and pale blue eyes; a prominent vertical scar runs over his left eye, which remains permanently closed. He typically wears a grey shirt with a dark green robe draped over one arm. Urha's defining characteristic, well-known among higher circles, is his absolute devotion to his daughter Mirha. He would reportedly do anything for her sake, suggesting a fierce protective instinct that could potentially override even priestly vows or conventional morality if her safety or well-being were threatened.

Personality: Devoted Father, Protective, Serious, Dutiful, Potentially Ruthless (for Mirha's sake).

Name: Airi Yui

Description: Airi Yui is an A+ ranked pure-blood human magician who doubles as a highly skilled fighter, uniquely blending magical prowess (Asvins-Asvins-Kubera attributes) with physical combat ability. She has long purple hair (styled differently across seasons, often incorporating buns or elaborate shapes) and purple eyes. Her younger brother is Claude Yui, the Priest of Death, with whom she shares an unusually close birth proximity (only three months apart, due to unique circumstances involving time manipulation). Airi is known for her fast-paced, action-oriented personality, sharp wit (often matching her friend Lorraine Rartia), and fierce loyalty. She holds Asha Rahiro in high regard, leading to frequent, often physical, fights with fellow admirer Ruche Seiran. Airi survived a fight with a Rakshasa and is skilled enough to consistently defeat Lorraine despite the rank difference. She possesses a powerful fusion spell (hoti asvins hoti kubera) enhanced by her attributes, providing rapid healing. Airi suffered amnesia related to the N0 Cataclysm, losing memories from before that time, including an encounter with Agwen Rajof, Kasak Rajof, and Taksaka. She is currently the President of the Atera Magicians Guild branch (formerly a guest lecturer).

Personality: Action-Oriented, Fiery, Loyal, Witty, Competitive (especially with Ruche), Skilled Fighter & Magician, Forgetful (due to amnesia), Holds Asha in high regard.

Name: Ernst Seiran

Description: Ernst Seiran is a responsible pure-blood human managing the Atera Magicians Guild under the often-erratic Ruche Seiran. He has short, light-blue hair and matching eyes (later adopting glasses) and Agni-Marut-Marut attributes, hinting at underlying power contrasting his usually administrative role. Ernst constantly attempts to keep Ruche focused on her duties, a thankless task for which he is frequently throttled, though he secretly finds amusement in her antics when she's not around. He handled the check-in for Asha Rahiro and Kubera Leez, and was subsequently tasked by Asha with ensuring Leez remained unaware of certain events (like Lorraine Rartia's investigation findings). Ernst survived the Guild fire caused by Agni's transcendental skill, demonstrating resilience amidst the chaos often surrounding his position. He represents a pocket of attempted order within the frequently dramatic events unfolding in Atera.

Personality: Responsible, Dutiful, Tolerant (begrudgingly), Secretly Amused, Discreet, Organized.

Name: Claude Yui

Description: Claude Yui is the immensely powerful AA-ranked Priest of Death in Rindhallow, holding the #2 magician spot on Willarv despite his reputation for utter indolence regarding his priestly duties. He is a pure-blood human with formidable triple Yama attributes, allowing him near-absolute mastery over death magic, including potent silent magic learned in a difficult childhood. He appears as a young man with long purple hair (possibly a wig due to medication side effects) matching his eyes, often hidden behind glasses and occasionally a fluffy green hat and cape ensemble. Claude shares a profoundly close, almost obsessive bond with his sister Airi Yui, maintained through an expensive exchange diary. This bond stems from a traumatic past: Airi was originally his older sister, died, and was resurrected by a god (facilitated by Eline Haias) in exchange for Claude serving the god and having his own lifespan extended after nearly dying in the Cataclysm; their history was then altered, making him the older brother. He frequently annoys colleagues like Laila Hemawati (who often disciplines him physically and uses him as a test subject) and Siera Sies by shirking work and delegating tasks, preferring travel or leisure. He also practices fortune-telling with tarot-like cards, usually predicting negative outcomes.

Personality: Lazy (Professionally), Dedicated (to Airi), Manipulative (subtly), Powerful, Avoidant, Irresponsible, Witty (often annoyingly so), Secretive (about his past/deal), Resigned (to Laila's experiments).

Name: Shuri (human)
