Description: Shuri was a pure-blood human male with distinctive pink hair and eyes, named by his father after the Nastika Shuri, 2nd King of the Yaksha clan, in a desperate bid to attract her attention. Fully expecting this action would lead to his death by the Nastika's hand, human Shuri was instead surprisingly offered a Sanyoga contract by her when she eventually appeared (resulting in his father's death instead). This marked the beginning of his career as a famous (or infamous) Fiendish Magician. He possessed an unusually high number of Sanyoga contracts: Sanyoga Shuri (his first, improving grip strength), Sanyoga Menaka (nullifying damage), Sanyoga Taksaka (unknown effect), and Sanyoga Vasuki (apparently useless, obtained with Taksaka). After Fiendish Magic disappeared from the world, Shuri faded from prominence, eventually taking on the role of a caretaker for the sick.

Personality: Carefree, Exceptionally Kind, Humble (despite former fame), Resigned (to fate).

Name: Kanna Ajes

Description: Kanna Ajes is a young Quarter girl (Sura heritage unknown) with distinct long green hair, green eyes, and a sprinkle of freckles across her nose, closely resembling her fraternal twin brother, Leto Ajes, and their unseen mother. She is the daughter of Praul Ajes, Principal of the Atera Magic Academy. Her Surya - Nil - Surya birthday attributes grant her potential solar magic affinity but also curse her with a significant spell failure rate due to the Nil attribute, a source of shared frustration with Leto. Kanna appears more serious and less mischievous than her twin, possessing a somewhat romanticized or idealistic view of gods and their summoning, contrasting sharply with the recent, terrifying demonstrations of divine power in Atera. She navigates childhood in the magically charged city, balancing typical sibling rivalry with the unique challenges of her mixed heritage and unpredictable magic.

Personality: Serious, Idealistic (about gods initially), Easily Frustrated (by magic failure), Studious (compared to Leto), Observant.

Name: Leto Ajes

Description: Leto Ajes is a young Quarter boy (Sura heritage unknown), the fraternal twin brother of Kanna Ajes and son of Atera Magic Academy Principal Praul Ajes. He shares his family's green hair and eyes, along with freckles, bearing a resemblance to both Kanna and their mother. His Surya - Nil - Surya attributes give him potential for solar magic but also inflict a 50% spell failure rate, a shared frustration with his sister, though he seems less bothered by it. Leto is notably mischievous, known for teasing Kanna, sneaking into restricted library sections, pestering his father, and attempting to read adult literature like "The Ravishing of Mrs. Witch". Unlike Kanna's initial idealism, Leto finds the raw power displayed during Sura conflicts (like Agni vs. Gandharva) exciting rather than purely frightening, showing a greater interest in thrilling action than academic magic.

Personality: Mischievous, Teasing, Excitable, Curious (about action/adult themes), Uninterested (in tedious magic), Rule-bender, Bold.

Name: Praul Ajes

Description: Praul Ajes is the middle-aged Quarter Principal of the Atera Magic Academy, characterized by his shoulder-length straw-colored hair and blue eyes, usually clad in a white mage suit and cowl. His Marut-Surya-Surya attributes denote significant magical potential, though he sometimes appears scatter-brained, struggling with time management despite being a competent leader who genuinely tries to protect his students and city. He is the father of twins Kanna and Leto, brother to Urga Ill, and distantly related (though unaware) to Jibril Ajes (his former magic test partner) and Brilith Ruin. Rumors persist, which he denies, that he is the son of the legendary Half-dragon Kroha from Taitalika. Praul deeply loves his family and longs to retire to spend time with them, but his formidable (unnamed) wife forces him to remain in his high-paying but demanding job until the twins graduate. He laments any failure to protect others and carries the weight of responsibility heavily.

Personality: Competent yet Scatter-brained, Dedicated Leader, Loving Father, Burdened by Responsibility, Idealistic (tries to save all), Resigned (to his job), Easily Flustered.

Name: Trisilla Ajes

Description: Trisilla Ajes was a powerful Quarter (Sura heritage unknown) who served as the Priest of Wind on the doomed planet Carte. Possessing rare triple Vayu attributes and an exceptionally high divine affinity (1500), she channeled immense power over air and sky. During the final evacuation of Carte in N5, Trisilla was aboard the last transport ship heading to Willarv. As the damaged vessel faltered, facing imminent destruction, she made the ultimate sacrifice. Knowing the cost, Trisilla depleted her own lifespan to perform a desperate summoning, calling upon the God of Wind, Vayu, himself. Her selfless act enabled Vayu to intervene, ensuring the ship's survival and passage to Willarv, saving the lives of those aboard, including potentially Rao Leez, though at the cost of her own existence. Her lineage connects her distantly to other Ajes family members across Willarv.

Personality: Self-sacrificing, Dutiful, Courageous, Determined, Resolute.

Name: Zard Blain

Description: Zard Blain is a highly skilled Quarter (Sura heritage unknown), known both as a formidable fighter and a powerful triple Kubera magician. He holds significant positions at the Kalibloom Martial Arts University, progressing from Lecturer to Dean by N23. Recognizable by his short, light greenish-gray hair, striking orange-red eyes, and distinctive asymmetrical attire (white cape, brown shirt/pants with only one long sleeve and one chap), Zard is a key figure in Kalibloom's leadership alongside Teo Rakan and Siera Sies. His triple Kubera attributes make him exceptionally suited for Earth magic and potentially holding the city's barrier. He sponsors the up-and-coming fighter Clari Utas. Zard maintains a close, almost sisterly relationship with Teo Rakan (though his feelings might run deeper), often showing concern for her well-being and reputation.

Personality: Formal, Reserved, Serious, Work-driven, Strict, Critical, Caring (especially towards Teo/Clari), Disciplined.

Name: Priga Cambell

Description: Priga Cambell is a Quarter (Sura heritage unknown) defined by her triple Surya attributes, marking her as a potent wielder of light magic. She has distinct blue hair and orange eyes. Initially introduced as a Priest candidate serving under Saha On in Eloth's Temple of Light, Priga ascended to the demanding role of Priest of Light herself in N16 following Saha's unexpected death. This sudden elevation thrust immense responsibility upon her, visibly altering her appearance between seasons; the strain of maintaining the Light barrier and fulfilling the duties previously held by the exceptionally capable Saha left her looking significantly more tired and burdened in Season 3. Her life changed drastically from promising student to primary guardian of Eloth's divine defenses.

Personality: Dutiful, Burdened, Overwhelmed, Resilient, Determined, Respectful (of Saha's memory).

Name: Eiraheeari Catroshife (Nickname: Ari)

Description: Eiraheeari Catroshife, usually called Ari due to his long name, is a young Quarter of unknown Sura heritage, distinguished by his messy pink hair often tied in twin ponytails, and brown eyes. His Brahma-Brahma-Brahma attributes grant him immense potential in creation magic, leading Lorraine Rartia to take him on as a disciple and employee at her Atera shop, rescuing him from potential uncertainty after his parents (originally from Isholy) died in the N0 Cataclysm (he was briefly cared for by Saha On). Unlike most Quarters, Ari's Sura ancestry is five generations removed, resulting in physical abilities nearly identical to a pure-blood, with slower aging being his main Quarter trait. Ari is polite, adheres to etiquette, dislikes conflict (often trying to mediate arguments between Lorraine and Airi Yui), and can be quite emotional, prone to tears in distress. He experienced considerable trauma during the Sura attack on Atera, being accidentally dropped from Lorraine's flying device and left dangling perilously until rescued later.

Personality: Polite, Emotional, Conflict-Averse, Studious (under Lorraine), Easily Distressed, Loyal.

Name: Tara Delion

Description: Tara Delion is an adult Quarter magician (heritage unknown) serving in Atera's Fire Temple, known for her Kubera-Agni-Agni attributes. A former prodigy who graduated from Eloth University, she was one of the three magicians who saved a young Brilith Ruin during the N0 Cataclysm. Tara has tan skin, shoulder-length curly blonde hair, light green eyes, and a beauty mark beneath her left eye. While often working alongside other unnamed temple magicians (like 'Split-fringe'), Tara tends to be the boldest, remaining in situations where others might flee, though she often follows the lead of others in discussions. Her duties include managing the temple library. She played a crucial role during Maruna's attack, breaking down Brilith's door (hoti kubera) when she was found injured, staying by her side, and being the sole magician to accompany Asha Rahiro to the barrier room despite grave misgivings and attempts to dissuade her. She witnessed Asha's collapse and Kubera Leez's subsequent arrival.

Personality: Bold (in action), Dutiful, Concerned (for Brilith/Asha), Follower (in conversation), Decisive (in crisis).

Name: Ping Haias

Description: Ping Haias is a Quarter magician (Sura heritage unknown) and a former classmate of Ran Sairofe at Mistyshore. He possesses notable physical traits – dark skin and bright green eyes – which, combined with his surname, fuel speculation about a possible relation to Anna Haias. Academically competent, Ping graduated ahead of Ran (sometime before N13). He has an honest and playful personality, often teasing Ran about his poorly concealed feelings for their former tutor and current professor, Rana Reimia. Despite the teasing, Ping offered genuine advice, recognizing Rana's high standing and Ran's deep affection, urging him to confess despite the inherent complication of their different aging rates (pure-blood vs. Quarter). He provides a glimpse into Ran's slightly more conventional peer group during his student days.

Personality: Honest, Playful, Teasing, Observant, Pragmatic, Friendly.
